purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 458 Srinagar (city code 1967); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: Jammu and Kashmir Revenue Department; Srinagar Development Authority; District Srinagar Administration
registryBasis: Jammu and Kashmir Revenue Department exposes a public land-records application shell, and DILRMP publishes Srinagar district cadastral-map digitization/geo-reference status. The Srinagar Development Authority publishes a 2035 land-use map, not parcel geometry. Publicly indexed ArcGIS MapServer parcel layers were metadata-inspected: their parcel-layer extents are in the Jammu area and miss the WUP Srinagar point; their schemas include owner/contact and property/address fields. No feature query was sent.

officialSources.observation: Government of India DILRMP provides tehsil-level map-digitization status for District Srinagar.
Jammu and Kashmir Revenue Department public land-record app shell; the initial page is not a parcel map and static client lists authentication endpoints.
Srinagar Development Authority identifies itself as a Government of J&K body and links to Master Plan 2035, Land Use Map and Online Building Permission.
SDA land-use map page links a static 2035 land-use PDF, not a parcel feature dataset.

searchQueries.result: Search surfaced the Jammu and Kashmir Revenue Department application and the Srinagar Development Authority land-use map. It did not establish a public parcel-geometry route; the Revenue client exposes authentication workflow.

accessReview.reason: The public JK Revenue page loads a secure land-records application shell; its static client contains authentication/OTP/captcha routes and no anonymous vector schema was established. The Srinagar Development Authority map is a static land-use plan. ArcGIS parcel-layer metadata on the indexed Jammu/Srinagar services shows that the feature layer extents do not cover the WUP target point; the broader layer schema also includes owner/contact and address identifiers, so no feature request was issued.

requestEvidence.observation: Static client includes sign-in, captcha, OTP and refresh-token routes plus an analytics route that maps revenue-record identifiers; no feature geometry schema was exposed in the inspected route strings. No route was called.
